items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: And Bunk Johnson was a strongman. He used to call me, he's the one giving me a nickname, or Brother, see?

ctx.x: A regular motor. That's right. A regular motor. That's the fifth, the Indian Pound band. And Bunk Johnson was a strongman. He used to call me, he's the one giving me a nickname, or Brother, see? You know, they used to call me Brother. Bunk Johnson. Bunk Johnson, yeah. You know Bunk Johnson, you know him? Well I didn't know him, though.
I knew him quite well in New York and down here, too.
